title: AI Benchmarks and Datasets for LLM Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Listed as part of the COMPL-AI evaluation suite via the 'Income Fairness' benchmark to test for the absence of discrimination in LLMs.

Cataloged through referenced standard benchmarks such as BBQ (Prejudiced Answers), BOLD (Biased Completions), and RedditBias, which evaluate the presence of biased outputs and prejudice in language models.

Evaluated in the WinoGrande dataset, which uses a systematic bias reduction methodology (the AFLITE algorithm) to remove human-detectable word associations and machine-detectable embedding associations from the data.

Assessed broadly by mapping various datasets and safety benchmarks (e.g., MultiTrust, AI Safety Benchmark v0.5) to the EU AI Act's 'Diversity, Non-discrimination and Fairness' (DNF) requirement to ensure AI systems do not exacerbate prejudice against vulnerable groups.
